items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Was he any relation to Hank Mobley?

ctx.x: Well, on that first time I got everybody back, but the second time I did not because Charlie Forbes had gone with Basie, and he stayed there. Bootie didn't come back. I got Dickie Harris Arriage. George Rhodes Rule came back. I had another bass player, another drummer, Al Jones out of Philadelphia. And I kind of thing, trying to think -- oh, James Mosely -- Mobley on bass.
Was he any relation to Hank Mobley?
I don't know. I don't think so. But I had a good band together. Eddy Lewis on trumpet --
